ayahOccurrences.text: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: نَّاضِرَةٌ is in the derivative form: نَاضِرَةٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ن/ض/ر   n–ḍ–r pure gold, good living; lushness, verdure, freshness, good looks; the upper crust of the society; purity.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 3 times in the Qur’an:
نَضْرَةٌ naḍratun 2 times and نَاضِرَةٌ nāḍiratun 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
نَاضِرَةٌ nāḍiratun [fem. act. part.] radiant, glowing, shining

(75:22) وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاضِرَةٌ there will be radiant faces on that Day.

entries.definitionHtml:
نَضْرَةٌ naḍratun [v. n.] freshness, radiance, glow

(83:24) تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ النَّعِيمِ you will recognise in their faces the radiance of bliss.
